data.title: Court payment order (Mahnbescheid) – gym membership fees of €364.70
data.summary: The Amtsgericht Beispielcoburg (Mahngericht für Bayern) issued a court payment order (Mahnbescheid) against Theresa Beispielhuber on behalf of Exempel Fitnesswelt GmbH & Co. KG for unpaid gym membership fees plus fees and costs, totalling €364.70; it was delivered to her personally on 20 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is a formal court payment order (Mahnbescheid) claiming unpaid gym membership fees plus returned-debit, court, and lawyer's fees, totalling €364.70. The court has not checked whether the claim is actually justified — it was issued only on the applicant's statement. You may either pay the applicant directly if you agree, or file an objection (Widerspruch) with the court if you dispute it; the app shows until when you can still decide. If you do neither, the applicant can ask the court for an enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid), which could lead to measures such as a bank account seizure. If you are unsure whether the debt is valid, consider getting advice from a consumer advice centre or a lawyer before the deadline.
